utility.name: AI for Cyber Security lab material
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: The CyBOK-funded AI-for-Cybersecurity notebooks (Anglia Ruskin University; Open Government Licence), unmodified at a fixed commit, in each account's home directory: lecturer and student notebooks on supervised, unsupervised and deep learning, spam detection, network anomaly detection, malware detection in network traffic and phishing domain detection.
